title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: People that keep their Zoom videos open are so weird
Ben doesn’t have his on anymore
Gardy didn’t have answer to your question. Has he lost the clubhouse? MY COLUMN:
What do you do with these interviews?
You were in one of them
I’m not in this one. Watching via our live stream to monitor the responses and what not
Do you have the taxi squad list yet?
The reason I ask is because I pretty much pieced it together with help from people and I’m going to fuck with Al and say I’m going to report it
But I’m not going to do it if it’s already been shared with you
I think replying to Tweets minimizes its reach
I can’t fully trust Twitter that it’s showing up in everyone’s timeline as if I tweeted it separately
Yeah, but it does amplify the original’ tweets reach
